name: Amedeo Air Four Plus Limited Red Ord NPV

announcements.headline: CANCELLATION OF ADMISSION TO TRADING
announcements.insight: Following the effective scheme of arrangement in June, admission to trading is cancelled. Shares are delisted as the corporate restructuring process concludes.

announcements.headline: Cancellation - Amedeo Air Four Plus Limited
announcements.insight: Following the June scheme of arrangement becoming effective, shares are now cancelled. This marks the final step in the corporate action initiated earlier this month.

announcements.headline: SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT BECOMES EFFECTIVE
announcements.insight: The scheme becomes effective following the June suspension. This finalizes the transaction for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Amedeo Air Four Plus Limited
announcements.insight: Suspension follows the update on scheme timetable and MSN206 redelivery condition. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding the scheme.

announcements.headline: AA4P Epsilon (MSN206) Redelivery Condition
announcements.insight: Following the June update, this filing details the redelivery condition for MSN206, a key step in the ongoing scheme timetable.

announcements.headline: UPDATE ON CONDITIONS AND SCHEME TIMETABLE
announcements.insight: Amedeo Air Four Plus Limited updates the scheme timetable. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent court meeting or sanction filings.
